# SetChannelFalloff

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [3D Sound](Blitz3D-3D-Sound)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetChannelFalloff:Void channel:Int32, mode:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [EmitSound](EmitSound). |
| `mode` | In | Int32 | required | `0` is the curve of this runtime, `1` the curve of the original and `2` the curve of SoLoud, see [CreateListener](CreateListener). Anything else is a runtime error. |

## Description

Picks the curve that the volume of one 3D sound falls off by with distance. It can be called while the sound plays and is heard from the next update. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* A channel starts with the curve that [SetFalloff](SetFalloff) has set, so this is only needed for sounds that differ from the default. A channel that is over is ignored.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; Two engines at the same distance: one with the curve of the original, one with the curve of this runtime.
a = EmitSound(engine, near)
b = EmitSound(engine, far)
SetChannelFalloff a, 1
SetChannelFalloff b, 0
```
